reuse.why: There is no existing duplicate-link check to reuse; the change writes one helper and calls it from each provider link function, using db.first like the surrounding code.

duplication.why: The rule lives once in assertBankAccountNotLinked; only a small call block (with the provider literal already repeated in each function) is repeated five times.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers that use it; link.ts, which already holds the shared linking DB helper findOrCreateBank, would have been a slightly more natural home.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and tests are added.

maintainability.why: Clear single definition of what counts as linked, but a new provider link function must remember to call it because the five link functions remain separate copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every provider link function routes through the new guard; no existing abstraction is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated beyond five one-line calls to the shared guard.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
